matcher_crash_between_claim_and_commit.scenario: A matcher worker claims candidates via claimCandidates and dies before committing core.run
matcher_crash_between_claim_and_commit.zero_premature_charges: Zero matches, zero participants, zero outbox, zero reservations, and zero ledger rows created at claim time
matcher_crash_between_claim_and_commit.claim_expiry_and_recovery: Once the claim lease lapses, subsequent matcher claims the survivors and commits the match cleanly, or clients continue searching; both accept and fund the pot exactly once

redis_wipe_after_assignment.scenario: Entire Redis namespace wiped (ephemera.wipeNamespace()) after match assignment commits in PostgreSQL
redis_wipe_after_assignment.durable_integrity: Match row, participants, and outbox rows remain byte-identical before and after wipe
redis_wipe_after_assignment.reconstruction: Both players' queue.status(actor) reconstructs {state: 'matched', mode, matchId, termsHash, expires} from PostgreSQL without needing Redis
redis_wipe_after_assignment.acceptance_integrity: Both players accept; game transitions to PLAYING and reserves funds normally without double-charges or stranded players

direct_challenge_race.scenario: Queued player accepts a competing direct challenge while queue assignment is in flight
direct_challenge_race.outcome: Queue assignment fails ALREADY_IN_MATCH under PostgreSQL aggregate identity mutex lock; queue transaction rolls back with 0 rows; direct match preserved; innocent partner requeued with original join time

tournament_occupancy_race.scenario: Queued player occupies a tournament table while queue assignment is in flight
tournament_occupancy_race.outcome: Queue assignment fails ALREADY_IN_MATCH; tournament occupancy preserved; innocent partner requeued with original join time

recovery_invariants.zero_ghosts: No participant without a match, no occupancy without a backing aggregate, no match with torn seat set, no actor in two live matches, no escrow discrepancy
recovery_invariants.clean_partition: Every actor is either queued, assigned, or explicitly cancelled; money matches state exactly
